question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown below. Which number is on the face opposite to the face showing ‘6’?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82a1b7f6b399b53b9091ebbb24d5eb6ff22678b774a1d8172f51bba9ebe8a137.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '6', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 3 and Dice 4,

When we move in clockwise direction starting from 4 we get;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bca
2db824435c27dd08848cc987d738262b7d03c21d54973cf000da32cf7e3.png] 

→ 4 ⇔ 4; **6 ⇔ 1**; 5 ⇔ 2

So, '1**' **will be the opposite face of '6'.

Hence, the correct answer is "1".
